## II – ADDITIONAL COSTS FOR WORK IN SPECIFIED AREAS (“LONDON WEIGHTING”)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > II – ADDITIONAL COSTS FOR WORK IN SPECIFIED AREAS (“LONDON WEIGHTING”)] The areas referred to in rule 45.3(1) are (within London) the areas served by the County Court hearing centres at Barnet, Brentford, Central London, Clerkenwell and Shoreditch, Edmonton, Ilford, Mayors and City of London, Romford, Wandsworth and Willesden and (outside London) the County Court hearing centres at Bromley, Croydon, Dartford and Uxbridge. ## TABLE 17: rule 45.64 – determination where parties agree on all issues except costs
